cases.title: Lid-driven cavity, Re 1000, 128 x 128 cells (Ghia)
cases.reference: Ghia, Ghia and Shin (1982), J. Comput. Phys. 48, 387-411, tables I and II (u on the vertical and v on the horizontal centreline, 17 points each; the numbers are transcribed from memory of the tables and were not re-checked against the paper). Quasi-2D cavity of N x N fluid cells, lid speed 0.1, Smagorinsky off, run to a steady state. The metric is the largest difference to the table in units of the lid speed; the tolerance was written down before the run.

calls.metric: u on the vertical centreline, max |difference|
v on the horizontal centreline, max |difference|

cases.title: Flow past a cylinder in a channel, Re 100: Strouhal number at 66 cells (Schaefer-Turek 2D-2)
cases.reference: Schaefer and Turek (1996), benchmark 2D-2, Strouhal number 0.2950 to 0.3050 (mid 0.3000); 66 cells across the channel (cylinder 16.1 cells), 30 000 steps. Tolerance 5 % of 0.300, written down before the run.
